# New Scramble for Africa: the GUI (plan 7.2-7.4; phase 6, z_plans/SCRAMBLE_PHASE6_GUI_PLAN.md).
# Windows: interface/TNO_Scramble.gui, generated by tools/scramble_gui/build_assets.py. The board and its two live
# panels are generated too, in TNO_Scramble_board_gui.txt; this file holds the topbar box. Everything shown is computed
# in common/scripted_effects/TNO_Scramble_board_scripted_effects.txt; the GUIs only read it, and redraw when the
# viewer's SFA_gui_dirty changes (SFA_gui_refresh). The AI plays the scramble through the pulse, never the GUI.

scripted_gui = {
	SFA_topbar = {
		# plan 7.3: the board's only entry, a box on the topbar's stat row for this outcome's patrons, the scramble
		# nations and the sovereign allies. A patron sees its regions consolidated and its income, a nation its region.
		context_type = player_context
		parent_window_token = top_bar
		window_name = "SFA_topbar_window"
		dirty = SFA_gui_dirty

		visible = {
			has_global_flag = SFA_active
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = SFA_patron
				has_country_flag = SFA_african_nation
				has_country_flag = SFA_sovereign_ally
			}
		}

		effects = {
			SFA_topbar_button_click = {
				# opens or closes the board for whoever clicked (the scope is the player). Opening recomputes the board
				# and the viewer's lists (targets, the pins' proxies) and clears the attention dot; the recompute is
				# shared, so every player's GUI redraws. Closing clears the selection and redraws only the viewer's.
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = SFA_board_open }
					SFA_board_close = yes
				}
				else = {
					SFA_board_recompute = yes
					SFA_build_target_list = yes
					SFA_build_pin_proxies = yes
					set_country_flag = SFA_board_open
					clr_country_flag = SFA_attention
					SFA_gui_refresh = yes
				}
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			SFA_topbar_regions_visible = { has_country_flag = SFA_patron }
			SFA_topbar_income_visible = { has_country_flag = SFA_patron }
			SFA_topbar_war_visible = {
				has_country_flag = SFA_patron
				check_variable = { SFA_proxies_at_war > 0 }
			}
			SFA_topbar_region_visible = { NOT = { has_country_flag = SFA_patron } }
			SFA_topbar_tick_visible = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = SFA_patron }
				check_variable = { SFA_home_region > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.SFA_consolidated^SFA_home_region = 1 }
			}
			SFA_topbar_alert_visible = { has_country_flag = SFA_attention }
		}

		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}
}
